name: fleet-availability-eligibility
objective: Unify Captain partner-fleet, availability and complete dispatch eligibility on authoritative DSH state while consuming WLT/Workforce projections without duplicating their truth.
truthOwner: DSH owns fleet membership, dispatch profile/candidate selection and assignment capacity; WLT owns financial eligibility; Workforce owns provider readiness/absence inputs where applicable; surfaces render intent/readback only.

tasks.objective: Close the full partner-fleet membership lifecycle without secret or scope leakage
tasks.currentProblem: Current Product Truth requires Captain redeem/list/disconnect, partner lifecycle visibility and redacted operator readback with single-use digest-only codes, versions, expiry, audit and notifications; all need same-candidate proof.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace Captain connection card through shared API, backend, persistence and partner/operator readers; repair every reproduced lifecycle, isolation, expiry, versioning, audit, notification or schema mismatch and remove any parallel local membership truth.
tasks.targetState: Captain, partner and operator observe one DSH fleet lifecycle; secret material is returned only when allowed, never persisted/exposed, and all legal transitions are versioned/audited/notified.
tasks.action: Run fleet backend/contract/database checks; exercise valid redeem, expired/revoked reuse, duplicate same-store membership, cross-Captain/store access, stale version and disconnect; repair at DSH owner and verify every affected surface/readback.
mustNotChange: Do not persist or expose plaintext/digest connection secrets beyond authorized issuance semantics.
Do not let operator mutate through a read-only fleet view.
Do not allow cross-store or cross-Captain membership access.
Do not retain local membership state as authoritative after refresh/restart.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid Captain can redeem once and list/disconnect only own memberships.
Expired/revoked/duplicate/stale/cross-scope cases fail with governed canonical readback.
Partner and operator show the same persisted lifecycle with required redaction.
Every lifecycle mutation is versioned, audited and notified where Product Truth requires it.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused fleet owner change while preserving audit/history and secret-handling safety; never restore a local parallel fleet truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused fleet lifecycle commit after positive and negative backend/database/contract checks pass.

tasks.objective: Close complete server-owned dispatch eligibility and capacity concurrency
tasks.currentProblem: The old package under-described eligibility as availability/service-area/capacity; current DSH also requires accreditation, WLT financial eligibility, profile freshness and no active absence, with transaction locking for capacity.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace every eligibility input and reason through DSH candidate selection/assignment validation and affected Captain/operator readback; add missing negative/concurrency/stale-projection tests and remove frontend final-eligibility calculations if found.
tasks.targetState: A Captain is offer-eligible only when every current server-owned prerequisite is valid at assignment time, and concurrent assignment attempts cannot exceed capacity or reuse stale financial/readiness truth.
tasks.action: Exercise accredited/unaccredited, available/unavailable, financially eligible/ineligible/expired, fresh/stale profile, absent/present, correct/wrong service area and at-capacity/concurrent cases; keep WLT arithmetic opaque to DSH; repair root cause and rerun PostgreSQL/contract/readback checks.
mustNotChange: Do not calculate final eligibility in a mobile/control-panel UI.
Do not duplicate WLT financial arithmetic inside DSH.
Do not bypass profile freshness, absence or financial eligibility to make local dispatch succeed.
Do not remove the transactional capacity serialization boundary without an equivalent stronger proof.
acceptanceCriteria: Every current prerequisite is enforced server-side both in discovery and final assignment validation where required.
Expired/missing financial projection, active absence, stale profile and wrong service area fail closed.
Concurrent offers cannot exceed Captain capacity.
Captain/operator reason/readback semantics match backend truth without local override.
No known stale/duplicate eligibility implementation remains.
tasks.rollback: Revert only the focused eligibility change while preserving fail-closed financial/readiness inputs and transactional capacity protection.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused eligibility/concurrency commit with database evidence; do not mix unrelated dispatch execution or finance feature work.
